name: BambooHR Café (Thomas2Go) Morning Rolled Oatmeal, Banana & Hard-Boiled Eggs
brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Café at BambooHR (Lindon, UT)
whyItWorks: Warm kettle-cooked rolled oats topped with a sliced ripe banana and a touch of honey or brown sugar plus two peeled hard-boiled eggs from the Thomas2Go grab-and-go cooler give you steady soluble fiber and clean protein at the office.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Scoop plain hot oatmeal and top with sliced banana and honey/brown sugar—skip dried cranberries, raw walnuts/almonds, and chia/flax seeds.
watchOuts: If grabbing a Greek yogurt parfait from the cooler, take a lactase tablet and pick around any nut/seed granola
